changelog: VORP MultiJob integration with job preservation and player job-limit checks.
Synchronized promotions, demotions, and firing across stored society jobs.
Employee roster support for inactive MultiJob employees.
Society transaction history with recent-entry caching.
Multi-location societies with separate inventory stashes.
Crafting queues, prepared orders, and crafting XP progression.
Customer receipts with configurable prices and expiration.
Paid orders deposit funds directly into the society account.
Optional Codex Ranch contamination integration with configurable product treatments.
Contamination metadata preserved through crafting and customer receipts.
Cached society data with controlled saves and batched persistence.
Retry handling for failed database saves.
Runtime limits and cleanup for prepared orders and receipts.
Server code organized into dedicated feature modules.
